Fixed-output converter; pin 1 VIN, 2 GND, 3 VOUT. Body 14 x 7.6 x 10.2 mm. Keep for DigiKey build. Pin 1 sleeve; pins 2 and 3 both tip. PJ-210B is not a drop-in replacement. Check physical lead/slot fit.
2.5 mm mono probe jack, right-angle THT
Existing provisional pad geometry retained. Exact manufacturer drawing and sample fit remain release gates. Not an Ethernet/magnetics jack.
Carrier side only. J1 is 12 V input; J7 is 3.3 V DEBUG. Same mate fits both: label/key harnesses and never interchange.
Carrier end of WT32 EXT harness; not the WT32's 1.25 mm connector. Pin 8 unused.
Socket only; ADC already owned. Confirm module pitch, edge offsets, insertion height and insulating support.

14 mm maximum seated height. 630 mA ripple at 10 kHz; verify actual input ripple and heating.

Direct 3.3 V GPIO drive through R6 at 4 kHz; pin 2 to ground. 6 mm maximum body height. Confirm useful audibility in the enclosure.
Passive piezo transducer, 4 kHz, 1-20 Vpp, D12 / P5
